description: Transparent starter rules for the synthetic software-project demo. Extend for your domain or supply actions and needs from your agent. Regex matching is not semantic understanding and does not reliably handle negation.

needs.offline_mode: Must core editing work without a connection?
needs.duplicate_prevention: What evidence determines whether repeating the operation is safe?
needs.storage_assumption: Which conditions justified the current storage architecture?
needs.hosting_policy: Are hosted services acceptable for this project now?
needs.auth_policy: Which authentication approach is currently approved?
needs.schema_compatibility: Must existing clients tolerate the schema change?
needs.release_policy: Which checks are required before release?
needs.query_privacy: Where may note content be processed for search?
needs.retention_rule: When should deleted data be permanently removed?
